title: headcount-sync-hiring-prep-scratchpad
content:
Headcount sync — hiring & interview loop prep (notes / scratchpad)

Meeting: Weekly headcount sync / hiring decisions
Owner: Alex Martinez (people-ops) — prepping for 1:1s and manager asks
Date: 2026-03-03 (sync time) — prep notes updated 2026-03-02

Goals for this sync:
- Quick triage of open reqs and offers in flight
- Confirm priority hires for Q2 and any reallocation of budget
- Review interview loop debriefs for candidates with offers/next steps
- Identify blockers (comp, start dates, bench capacity) and owners

Agenda (15-20m):
1) Quick numbers (30s each team) -> current reqs / offers / targets
2) Deep dive on top 5 critical reqs (SWE-backend, Infra infra-sim, SRE)
3) Candidate debrief highlights (loops completed since last sync)
4) Decisions needed from managers (comp approvals / expedite reqs)
5) AOB + action items

Current snapshot (to read aloud):
- Total open headcount (net new): 8 (engineering 5, SRE 2, product 1)
- Offers extended: 2 (SWE-B - offer 1, Infra - offer 1)
- Offers accepted: 1 (SWE-B accepted for 2026-04-15 start)
- Offers declined: 1 (Infra rol - candidate took competing offer)
- Pipeline: 18 active candidates across top reqs, 7 in onsites, 4 in loop debriefs

Top priority reqs (recommended order):
1) SWE - Backend (x2) — critical for infra scaling and throughput work. Target start dates: Apr/May.
2) SRE (x1) — support new dedicated clusters; high impact for reliability SLA.
3) Infra Engineer (quant/ops) (x1) — lower pipeline -> consider contracting short term.
4) Product Manager (x1) — backfill for PM rotation in mid-April.

Notes from recent interview loops (high level):
- Candidate: "Ravi P." (SWE Backend) — strong systems design, slower on coding question but good culture fit. Hiring mgr: Samir. Recommendation: move to final onsite + take-home. Slack thread: #hiring-ravi.
- Candidate: "Maya L." (SRE) — excellent observability experience, flagged for salary band mismatch. Manager: Jenna. Next: comp calibration with Priya.
- Candidate: "Contractor Joe" (Infra ops) — prefers contract -> asked about conversion to FTE later. Discuss bench budget.

Debrief action items (assignments / due dates):
- Priya: run comp calibration for Maya (SRE) and confirm salary band + approval by 2026-03-05. (PRIYA)
- Samir: schedule final onsite for Ravi and provide panel notes by 2026-03-04. (SAMIR)
- Alex: confirm headcount reprioritization with Eng leads; propose swap infra req -> contractor conversion path by 2026-03-06. (ALEX)
- Jenna: follow up with declined candidate feedback and re-engage top-of-pipeline set. (JENNA)
- People-ops: prepare offer letter template updates for expedited offers (legal to sign off) by 2026-03-07.

Questions / risks to surface in sync:
- Can we accelerate comp approvals for SRE req? SLA risk if delayed past mid-April.
- Budget: do we have flexibility to convert 1 contractor to FTE without headcount change? Who signs off?
- Interview capacity: interviewers overloaded next 2 weeks (on-call + travel). Consider blocking days or rotating panel.

Prep notes for 1:1s with managers (quick prompts):
- Samir: confirm top 3 must-haves vs nice-to-haves for SWE reqs; ask for internal ref candidates; check interview availability windows.
- Jenna: status on SRE pipeline; appetite to raise comp; discuss start-date flexibility.
- Priya: escalate any headcount policy changes from finance; confirm approval SLAs.

Draft language for manager asks (copy/paste):
- "Can you confirm the top 3 non-negotiable skills for this role by EOD so we can tighten the candidate screen?"
- "We have one strong SRE in loop but need comp approval to close — please escalate to Priya if you can sign off earlier."

Follow-ups for next sync (notes to self):
- Re-run pipeline numbers after final on-sites complete (due 2026-03-05)
- Add forecasted hiring burn (headcount vs budget) to slide for leadership if any larger reprioritization is proposed
- Keep a running list of bench contractors that can be converted if headcount shifts

Raw scratchpad / things to mention quickly (bullet-style):
- Slack refs: #hiring-ravi, #hiring-maya, #recruiting-ops
- Jira tickets: ENG-427 (req backlog), HR-112 (budget approval)
- Confluence: Headcount Q2 page (link above)
- Potential blocker: finance wants 2-week delay on new reqs for APAC payroll changes

Notes to self: keep this doc informal. Move final decisions to confluence once agreed. Capture manager sign-offs in the HR system (Greenhouse/Jira).

End of scratchpad.
